ResearchProjectDef.label: wraith-human hybridisation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Combine Wraith genetic manipulation with feeding-resistance research to graft a limited Wraith-derived phenotype into an existing living humanlike. The Growth Chamber mutates the exact subject in place: ordinary nutrition remains, only a small unstable Life Force reserve and Partial Feed are gained, regeneration cannot rebuild missing anatomy, telepathy is limited to a surface-thought probe, and recurring instability flares remain a permanent cost.
